---
author: Jane Doe
date: 2025-04-30
citation: true
google-scholar: true
appendix-cite-as: [display, bibtex]
format: html
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ['#quarto-citation']
        - ['meta[name="citation_title"]']
---

A document without a `title` still renders the citation appendix, with no `citation_title` meta tag.
